romans.1.p1.b1.text: Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus, …

romans.1.p1.b2.text: … called to be an apostle, and set apart for the gospel of God

romans.1.p2.b1.text: the gospel He promised beforehand through His prophets in the Holy Scriptures,

romans.1.p2.b3.text: … to call all those among the Gentiles to the obedience that comes from faith. And you also are among those who are called to belong to Jesus Christ.

romans.1.p2.b4.text: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints: …

romans.1.p3.b1.text: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith is being proclaimed all over the world.

romans.1.p3.b2.text: in my prayers at all times, asking that now at last by God’s will I may succeed in coming to you.

romans.1.p3.b3.text: For I long to see you …

romans.1.p3.b4.text: … that you and I may be mutually encouraged by each other’s faith.

romans.1.p4.b1.text: … how often I planned to come to you (but have been prevented from visiting until now) …

romans.1.p4.b2.text: I am obligated both to Greeks and non-Greeks, both to the wise and the foolish.

romans.1.p4.b3.text: That is why I am so eager to preach the gospel also to you who are in Rome.

romans.1.p5.b1.text: I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, …

romans.1.p5.b2.text: … first to the Jew, then to the Greek.

romans.1.p5.b3.text: … just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.”

romans.1.p6.b1.text: The wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of men …

romans.1.p6.b2.text: … because God has made it plain to them.

romans.1.p6.b3.text: … being understood from His workmanship, so that men are without excuse.

romans.1.p7.b1.text: For although they knew God, they neither glorified Him as God nor gave thanks to Him, …

romans.1.p7.b2.text: … and darkened in their foolish hearts. Although they claimed to be wise, they became fools,

romans.1.p7.b3.text: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images of mortal man and birds and animals and reptiles.

romans.1.p8.b1.text: Therefore God gave them over in the desires of their hearts to impurity …

romans.1.p8.b2.text: They exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, …

romans.1.p8.b3.text: Furthermore, since they did not see fit to acknowledge God, He gave them up to a depraved mind, to do what ought not to be done.

romans.1.p9.b1.text: They have become filled with every kind of wickedness, evil, greed, and depravity. They are full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, and malice. …

romans.1.p9.b2.text: … they disobey their parents. They are senseless, faithless, heartless, merciless.

romans.1.p9.b3.text: Although they know God’s righteous decree that those who do such things are worthy of death, they not only continue to do these things, but also approve of those who practice them.
